subject: Coordinating Redwood onboarding — two-session plan (console + API)
messages:
From: Asha Rao <asha.rao@catalysthealth.com>
To: Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Sat, 10 Apr 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Coordinating Redwood onboarding — two sessions needed

Hi Grace / Marissa,

Thanks again for the quick demo last week — the team at Catalyst loved the performance numbers. We are ready to start onboarding and would like to schedule two distinct sessions: a Console walkthrough for product owners and an API enablement for our engineers. Ideally the sessions would be in the same week so our team can digest the console material before hands-on API work.

A few constraints on our side:
- We are Pacific time (PST).
- Product owners can do afternoons (1:00–4:00 PM PT) on Tue/Wed.
- Engineering prefers mornings (9:00–12:00 PM PT) on Thu/Fri.
- We will bring a security representative for a brief compliance Q&A — they asked to be looped in.

Can you propose a two-session cadence that fits those windows? Also let us know if you need any pre-provisioned sandbox access or example payloads.

Thanks,
Asha Rao
Head of Integrations | Catalyst Health
asha.rao@catalysthealth.com
(415) 555-0198

Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Sat, 10 Apr 2027 10:05:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Coordinating Redwood onboarding — two sessions needed

Hi Asha — great to hear, and glad the demo was useful. 

Proposed plan (keeps product owners first):
1) Console walkthrough (overview, access, RBAC, dashboards) — Tue Apr 20, 2027, 2:00–3:30 PM PT
2) API enablement (sandbox keys, streaming, KV cache tips, sample integrations) — Thu Apr 22, 2027, 10:00–11:30 AM PT

If those times look good I'll send calendar invites and a mutual action plan. We can split the API session into 90 min if your engineers want a short lecture + hands-on lab.

Pre-reqs we'd like from you: list of attendee emails for role-based access, any allowlisted IP ranges (if you use a proxy), and a primary contact for sandbox provisioning. If you can confirm by EOD Mon (Apr 12) we can reserve the slots and assign facilitators.

I've attached two short stubs: onboarding-deck.pdf (30-min console deck) and facilitator-runbook.docx (session checklist).

Attachments:
- onboarding-deck.pdf (PDF)
- facilitator-runbook.docx (DOCX)

Thanks — Grace

--
Grace O'Connor

grace_oconnor@redwood.ai | +1 (415) 555-0122
